entries.description: Standard banana oat protein shake, doubled oats (100 g banana, 1 scoop whey, 150 mL full-cream milk, 30 g rolled oats)

exercise.source: Group Cycle Connect and Samsung Health / Galaxy Watch3 screenshots
exercise.notes: Sunday RPM with Cindy. Machine 49:53, 23.1 km, 656 kcal, 1189 MOVEs, 196 W average, 406 W max, 77 rpm average cadence. Watch 43:24, 499 kcal, 152 bpm avg and 178 bpm max; brief apparent optical HR dropouts. Keep device calorie estimates separate; do not sum. Subjective workout feedback not yet supplied.

post_workout_feedback.physical_strength: Felt strong and capable despite fatigue
post_workout_feedback.mental_effort: High; consciously pushed through difficult effort
post_workout_feedback.user_feedback: I was fatigued and working hard and knew I had to push, but I felt strong. I felt like my base fitness could get me through even though I wasn't on top of the workout. It was a real grind, felt good, but was really hard.
post_workout_feedback.interpretation: User perceives improving base fitness; single workout cannot establish trend.
